title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

reports.title: Former Costa Mesa Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Contacting His Mistress Thousands of Times Through Text, Phone Calls, and Social Media Messages, Including More than 100 Times in a Day, Illegally Accessing Confidential Law Enforcement Databases to Track Romantic Rivals, Ex-girlfriend, and Wife

summary:
A former officer from the Costa Mesa Police Department has admitted to contacting his mistress thousands of times through text messages, phone calls, and social media. On at least one day, he reached out more than 100 times. He also illegally accessed confidential law enforcement databases to track people he considered romantic rivals, along with his ex-girlfriend and his wife.

The former officer pleaded guilty to charges tied to this conduct. He now awaits sentencing, but the report did not list a specific court date or the penalty he could receive. The case involves both the repeated unwanted messages and the misuse of police records to monitor several people in his personal life.
